contributes.instructions: Pasting HTML on the canvas (Cmd+V with markup as plain text, or text/html that is more than a single paragraph of prose; a paragraph copied from a page lands as canvas text through the Text plugin instead) makes a new page of the project: the pasted text is written as a new html file, as it arrived — its <style> and <link> kept, nothing cleaned or folded — named index.html in a project with no page yet, else after its <title> made file-safe (-2 and on while the name is taken), at the project's root. Each remote image, video, audio, text track and font file it names is downloaded into assets/ and named there; one that cannot be stays as written, and the console says which and why. A viewport of the page, 960px wide, is placed at the view's center and selected, as one undo step. A paste with no project open is refused, in Daydream's words, and one of more than 10,000 elements or four million characters is refused before anything is written. No gates run on a paste; lint judges the page as it judges every page.
